results.title: A Question of Mercy
results.excerpt:
A Question of Mercy
The headmistress slides a file across her desk. A second-year stole from the apothecary to pay for a sick mother's medicine. The rules say expulsion. "You're a student," she says. "Tell me what a student thinks is just."
Argue for mercy
You argue for an hour.
